values.note: Book online through River Riders (FareHarbor), 1-7 nights online; call (304) 535-2663 to request a specific site (not guaranteed). Weekends typically book out 2-4 weeks ahead, holidays up to 6 months. Check-in from 4 PM at the main office (408 Alstadts Hill Rd; the campground address is not GPS-traceable); a one-way narrow tunnel with 11 ft clearance on Bakerton Rd - get directions from staff. A Friday-night River View booking on 2026-10-30 offered only 2 or 3 nights. Monthly sites Nov 1 - Mar 31 by lease (background check $40 per adult, RVs 10 years old or newer).

flags: RV sites an afterthought? Not really: River Riders sells four RV site classes (Premium Riverfront new for 2026, Riverfront, Creek Front, River View) with full 30/50A hookups on its own booking flow. But it is a mixed-use outfitter base - 'Our canopy tour operates above the campground', 'The boat launch is used by River Riders to drop off some of their guests', 24/7 trains beside it - and the cheapest River View sites are rated '20-25' suggested max length' and '10+ Feet in Height and 25 Feet Max Length' (EKKO's 23 ft fits).
Access: FareHarbor booking notes warn of a '1 way narrow tunnel with 11' max height in Bakerton Rd, please get directions from staff' - worth AWH's eye for EKKO's height.

US$50 gate: base $39.99 (River View, Nov 2026 weekday), Riverfront $49.99 - under. Summer and premium-site prices were not yet on sale, so peak rates could be higher. No gateway within 40 km by gateways.py (Harpers Ferry NHP is not on its list; Shenandoah NP 61 km); no trip references.
Long-stay: monthly leases Nov 1 - Mar 31 only ('limited Monthly Rentals primarily from November - March', lease + $40 background check); nightly sites are sold online, so it passes.
